Fire Lichen Mushroom

Mushroom (Duergar Alcohol)

  • Found In: Underdark only. Grows near geothermal heat sources — volcanic vents, magma-adjacent tunnels, and anywhere the barrier to the Elemental Plane of Fire runs thin. Common around Gracklstugh and other volcanically active regions.

  • Value: 3–8 gp per bundle as a spice or ingredient. 10–15 gp per bottle as finished duergar liquor/drink.

  • Appearance: Pale orange-white stalks.

  • Lore: Ground and fermented into a fiercely hot, spicy paste. Spread on sporebread or added to soups and stews. Counts as a flavoring, not a ration on its own — but makes any bland Underdark meal significantly more palatable. Fire lichen is how Underdark cuisine gets flavor. Without it, the diet of most Underdark races is almost entirely bland fungi and stale water. it's a comfort and a trade good.

  • Species — Duergar: Fire lichen is home to them. Any duergar NPC who smells it cooking immediately relaxes. Offering duergar fire lichen paste or liquor is a reliable social gesture — it signals Underdark cultural literacy and earns genuine warmth (by duergar standards, which is a slight softening of their permanent scowl).

  • Species — Surface Dwellers: The paste is genuinely too hot for most surface folk who haven't built up tolerance.

  • Drink — Fire Lichen Liquor: Fermented fire lichen stalks + sealed gourd, Brewer's Supplies and proficiency (2 hrs during a Rest, no roll required), 2 weeks fermentation = fire lichen liquor. Non-duergar drinkers: DC 12 Con save or take 1d2 fire damage (internal heat — not magical, just extremely spicy). Duergar: no save needed, they enjoy it. Counts as strong alcohol regardless.

  • Addiction: Low


Nimergan Mushroom

Mushroom (Duergar Alcohol)

  • Found In: Underdark. Primarily cultivated in and around Gracklstugh, the City of Blades — the duergar city on the shores of the Darklake.

  • Value: Raw mushroom: minimal, worth farming not selling whole. Nimergan drink (standard): 5 sp per glass. Nimergan drink (overfermented/potent): 10 gp per glass.

  • Appearance: A giant mushroom species. Its brown bumps are a separate parasitic fungus living on the stem — that parasite is what ferments into the alcohol.

  • Lore: Duergar are especially fond of the drink and challenge outsiders to drinking contests using the overfermented version — more resistant to its effects, they watch as opponents fall into a coma or die. It's a tradition, a trap, and entertainment at once. Gracklstugh duergar also brew Darklake Stout — a separate mushroom beer for everyday use. Nimergan is the prestige drink; being offered it instead of stout is a meaningful social signal.

  • Species-Specific:

    • Elves: Elves who drink standard nimergan make the save at disadvantage — their biology processes the fungal alcohol poorly. On a failed save they are Poisoned for 2 hours instead of 1.

    • Halflings: Halflings find the standard drink genuinely enjoyable despite the taste — they make the save normally but on a failure become loud, friendly, and Charmed toward everyone present for the duration. Addiction High for them.

  • Crafting — Brewing: Seal a mature nimergan into a cask to die. The parasitic fungus feeds on the dying stem and ferments into drinkable alcohol. Fermented too long, it becomes the potent overfermented version. (DM determines fermentation duration.)

  • Drink — Standard: As an Action or Bonus Action, drink a glass. Counts as strong alcohol. DC 12 Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned (drunk) for 1 hour. Tastes deeply unpleasant to non-duergar — earthy, bitter, faintly metallic.

  • Drink — Potent (Overfermented): As an Action or Bonus Action, drink a glass. DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become Incapacitated for 1d4 hours. On a natural 1: unconscious and at risk of alcohol poisoning — requires DC 14 Medicine check or the character drops to 0 HP at the end of their next Long Rest. Duergar have advantage on both saves.

  • Food: Not Edible unless brewed as described

  • Addiction: Medium
